claim: OpenVision 2.14 adds ChatGPT/SuperGrok sign-in and follows with Keychain credential fix
summary: The third-party MIT-licensed iOS companion for Meta glasses added subscription sign-in paths and Grok support; subsequent main-branch work moved API keys/tokens out of plaintext settings into iOS Keychain. The project warns its ChatGPT subscription route uses an undocumented Codex CLI integration surface and can break.
